dedupe_keys.name: geoinfomex geoscience and mining map service of the servicio geologico mexicano

description: Mexico's national geoscience map service. The GeoInfoMex page describes geoscientific information at the service of Mexico, with tools for layers, satellite imagery, search, identify and download, an attribute table, earthquakes and mining property information. It notes that geological-mining mapping began in 1995 on the NAD 27 datum and now uses ITRF 92, which causes gaps or overlaps at sheet boundaries, and links datasets on the national open data portal for aeromagnetic maps by state, the geological map of Mexico at 1:250,000, geochemical maps at 1:250,000 and municipal mining inventories. It is free to use online. Coverage is Mexico. Caveats: the page states that all copyright is reserved to the SGM, that use requires attribution and that reproduction for profit needs written permission; the linked municipal mining inventory page returned 404 on the new open data portal. For simulation it locates mining districts and mining concessions as raw-material supply nodes and exposure sites. A related catalogue record is USGS MRDS.
